versions.changelog: Adds update admission/rehearsal/recovery guidance (retired-state-format refusals, TMPDIR canary failures, half-migrated SQLite after a rolled-back update), macOS launchd/keychain traps (launchctl submit relaunch loops, one-shot GUI-domain jobs for keychain SecretRefs over SSH, Sparkle staged updates), and plugin pin/consent/provenance notes. Replaces the removed 'openclaw tasks' commands with 'status --all'/'audit', fixes log paths, and drops installs.json and plugins.bundledDiscovery.

claw-mechanic 1.0.3

- Expanded and clarified diagnosis steps for gateway/service/config issues (now explicitly verify runtime binary).
- Improved approval troubleshooting by adding verification of route latency versus timeout.
- Minor wording and organization enhancements for better step clarity.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
Document command cron conversion and narrow wrapper allowlists for recurring maintenance jobs.
Generalize claw-mechanic guidance for messaging channels and model providers; add context-engine generated-session repair pattern.
Initial public release: OpenClaw diagnostic, update, cron, model, plugin, approval, memory, and channel repair workflow.
